params.message:
Research drafts: briefs an agent sets out through the gateway, reviewed in Studio

A research draft holds a title, what to find out, context, sources and a status. The owner's
agents set one out through the control gateway (POST /control/act, kind studio.research_draft,
B2), verified here against the DID document like Stocklist's control endpoint; editors list,
edit, approve, dismiss and start a piece from it on /research-drafts.
